calendarNotes: Cobb County School District starts the 2026-2027 school year on Monday, August 3, 2026 and ends the student year on Wednesday, May 19, 2027. The official year-at-a-glance calendar marks Fall Break on September 21–25, Thanksgiving Break on November 23–27, Winter Break on December 21, 2026–January 1, 2027, Spring Holidays on April 5–9, student holiday/staff days on July 27–31, November 3, January 4, and May 20–21, digital learning days on August 17, October 12, December 1, and March 1, elementary and middle school conference week on October 13–16, and early release for all grade levels on December 17–18 and May 17–19.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cobb County school start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for Cobb County School District is Monday, August 3, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Cobb County in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Cobb County Spring Holidays in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Holidays run Monday, April 5 through Friday, April 9, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Cobb County School District in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027. January 4 is a student holiday/staff day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fall Break for Cobb County Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, September 21 through Friday, September 25, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Cobb County have digital learning days in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar marks digital learning days on August 17, October 12, December 1, and March 1.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Cobb County early release days in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Early release for all grade levels is scheduled for December 17–18, 2026 and May 17–19, 2027. Elementary and middle school conference week runs October 13–16 with early release for those levels only.

calendarFaqs.q: What is Cobb County elementary and middle school conference week?
calendarFaqs.a: For 2026-2027, Cobb marks Tuesday, October 13 through Friday, October 16 as elementary and middle school conference week with early release for elementary and middle schools only.

calendarFaqs.q: If I live in Marietta, which school district calendar should I use?
calendarFaqs.a: Most Cobb County addresses use the Cobb County School District calendar, but Marietta City Schools is a separate school system. Confirm your assigned district before using the dates on this page.

customSections.label: Who This Calendar Applies To
customSections.content: This page covers the Cobb County School District year-at-a-glance calendar. Marietta City Schools follows a separate calendar, and individual schools may publish additional dates for testing, athletics, performances, graduation, and other campus events.

customSections.label: Easy-to-Miss Dates
customSections.content: In addition to the major breaks, the 2026-2027 Cobb calendar includes digital learning days, conference-week early release for elementary and middle schools, early release for all grade levels, and student holiday/staff days that affect attendance.

groups.label: Digital learning and early release
items: Digital learning days are August 17, October 12, December 1, and March 1.
Elementary and middle schools have conference-week early release October 13–16.
All grade levels have early release December 17–18 and May 17–19.
May 19 is both an early release day for all grade levels and the last day of school.

groups.label: Student holiday/staff days
items: The official calendar labels July 27–31 as student holiday/staff days before classes begin on August 3.
November 3 is a student holiday/staff day.
January 4 is a student holiday/staff day after Winter Break; students return January 5.
May 20–21 are student holiday/staff days after the final student day.

yearNumbers.label: First Day
yearNumbers.detail: Students begin school on Monday, August 3, 2026.

yearNumbers.label: Digital Learning Days
yearNumbers.detail: Digital learning days are marked August 17, October 12, December 1, and March 1.

yearNumbers.label: Early Release Windows
yearNumbers.detail: Early release for all grade levels appears December 17–18 and May 17–19.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2025-2026 Calendar
content: The first day moves from August 4 in 2025 to August 3 in 2026.
The last day moves from May 20 in 2026 to May 19 in 2027.
Fall Break shifts one day earlier, from September 22–26 in 2025 to September 21–25 in 2026.
Each digital learning date moves one day earlier in its respective month: August 17, October 12, December 1, and March 1.
